lines.en: I can't believe they're going to fight over me.
I guess people have fewer choices as they get older.
It's 410. I don't think he's going to show.
Oh, come on, man. Believe in something.
On the desk of Andrew Bernard.
Dear Dwight, by now you have received my note.
How are you? I am well.
You are no doubt wondering why I have left this note.
It has come to my attention that at any physical match with you I would surely be bested.
The soft underbelly of my refined upbringing is my soft underbelly.
There's Andy. He's in his car.
You guys, what is he doing?
The Prius is silent if he keeps it under five miles per hour.
Andy's running over Dwight with his car.
Get out and face me like a man!
I'm a bigger man than you'll ever be!
I would never sleep with another man's Fiatte!
You don't know how to take care of her!
All you do is dress fancy and sing "Oh la la la la la la la la".
You're not a man! You don't know how to take care of her! All you do is dress fancy and sing "Oh la la la la la la la!" What does that mean? You can't even protect her!
Protect her from what? Bears, you idiot? When's the last time you saw a damn bear in Scranton?
No. My right one's falling asleep a little bit.
Go away, Tuna! I'm winning this!
Yeah, back off! This isn't your fight!
Oh, how much is this gonna cost?
Trust Fund will take care of that!
What did you say? I'm sorry, I couldn't hear you.
You're like a Sasquatch! You live in the woods!
Sasquatches are the strongest animal on the planet!
So fine, call me a Sasquatch!
I don't get it! How could she be sleeping with you this whole time and only sleep with me twice?
